It’s redefining how teams work, what’s possible to build, and who gets to build it.</p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">A new generation of builders is emerging, and they think differently about how software should work. <b class="in-[p]:font-semibold">We call them GTM builders.</b></p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">They aren’t constrained by titles or roles. Instead, they think like builders, see how things should work, and then make it real. They know how their GTM should run, and they expect tools to let them build their vision.</p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">These are teams that don’t wait for vendor roadmaps, a 12 month implementation timeline, or settle for a tool’s constraints. They’re the GTM engineer who sees automation opportunities everywhere; the RevOps leader who architects processes from first principles; the technical founder who refuses to let software limit their vision.<!-- --></p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">We know this because these builders are <em>our users</em>. 5,000 paying customers now run their go-to-market on Attio, including incredible companies like Lovable, Granola, Modal, Replicate, and Public. We’re also on track to 4x ARR growth this year.</p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">But what’s most telling isn’t just the adoption. It’s how these teams are using our platform. They don’t just use Attio, they build on it. And we’ve been amazed at what they’ve been building.</p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">They're scripting workflows, extending interfaces, and spinning up custom tooling in hours, not months. <b class="in-[p]:font-semibold">They're molding Attio to exactly fit their GTM motions, redefining what CRM can be.</b></p><blockquote class="not-first:mt-10 not-last:mb-10 border-white-800 border-l py-1 pl-5 font-medium text-secondary-foreground"><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">“Attio finally lets us build a CRM that fits our business, instead of forcing us to fit the software. The ability to adapt our system as our GTM evolves has been transformative for how we operate.” — <span><a href="https://attio.com/customers/modal" class="-mx-px rounded-sm px-px underline transition-colors duration-400 hover:duration-150 active:duration-50 text-link-foreground decoration-transparent hover:text-link-strong-foreground hover:decoration-link-strong-foreground active:text-link-strong-foreground">Modal</a></span></p></blockquote><h2 id="built-on-ai-primitives" class="scroll-my-24 relative not-first:mt-15 not-last:mb-5 font-bold text-2xl text-primary-foreground lg:not-first:mt-20">Built on AI primitives</h2><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">Legacy CRMs still assume a world of manual inputs, rigid workflows, and human-only operators. They were built for the old software paradigm where teams adjusted to the tool instead of shaping it to their needs.</p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">AI-native CRM requires a completely different foundation: one that gives teams control over their data, the freedom to build their own systems, and the ability for humans and AI to work side by side.</p><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">That’s why we’ve been building Attio on the core primitives of AI-native software — and applying them to CRM. And more is coming: agent collaboration and advanced permissions are in active development, which will unlock even greater power as we ship them.</p><blockquote class="not-first:mt-10 not-last:mb-10 border-white-800 border-l py-1 pl-5 font-medium text-secondary-foreground"><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">“What’s been so impactful about Attio is how AI is seamlessly woven into the platform, making it easy to experiment with and build out new functionalities which genuinely enrich our existing processes.” — Legora</p></blockquote><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">And this is only the start: we’re building toward a world where anyone can shape Attio and their GTM through natural language: building automations, interfaces, and entire workflows just by describing what you need.</p><h2 id="what-comes-next" class="scroll-my-24 relative not-first:mt-15 not-last:mb-5 font-bold text-2xl text-primary-foreground lg:not-first:mt-20">What comes next</h2><p class="not-first:mt-5 text-pretty [h4+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2.5 [p+&:not(:first-child)]:mt-5">This $52m Series B represents more than growth capital.
